description: Fresh random sample from entire course - independent verification round
scoring_criteria: Japanese particle usage, honorific consistency, verb conjugations, natural word order, pedagogical value

worst_phrases.japanese: 彼女は誰にも言いません
worst_phrases.reason: TENSE ERROR: English uses past tense 'didn't tell' but Japanese uses present tense 言いません (imasen). Should be 言いませんでした (imasen deshita) for past tense. This is a significant grammatical mismatch that could confuse learners.

Incomplete phrase. あそこの is a noun modifier meaning 'of over there' but needs a noun to complete it. Should be あそこのもの (that thing over there) or simply あれ (that one). Low pedagogical value as a fragment.
Fragment with slightly unnatural word order. More natural would be 残念ながら今日は with topic marker. As a fragment, limited pedagogical value.

systematic_issues.description: One phrase shows English past tense incorrectly translated to Japanese present tense
Several phrases are fragments that feel incomplete or end awkwardly (trailing conjunctions, missing nouns)
Some complex sentences have double は or double が which, while grammatical, can sound slightly awkward
